title: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains a Use of… (CVE-2026-80271)
description: Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition versions prior to 5.36.00.16 contain a vulnerability involving the use of a hard-coded cryptographic key. This flaw could allow a low privileged attacker with local access to potentially achieve remote code execution. The vulnerability is classified as high severity with a CVSS score of 7.8.
